title: Restricted-component polynomial bounds
statement: Let an input consist of a positive dimension $n$, positive integers $a,d$ with $2a\le d$, and an integer Fourier bound $B\ge1$. For its associated restricted-weight input, let $A$ be the sum of the inner and outer algorithm scales; its polynomial budget is $2^{20}(A+1)^8$. The restricted-weight construction work, the stage query budget, and the restricted local work are each at most this budget.
hypotheses_covered: Positive accuracy numerator and denominator encoding
Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Fourier bound is at least one
